title: LoCo-WAM: Test-Time Training as Long Context for World-Action Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.26853v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World-action models guide robot actions by predicting what happens next, but typically condition on a short observation history. Extending this history increases computation at every decision and can require a separately trained model. We introduce LoCo-WAM, which learns from the outcomes of its actions through test-time training while keeping the same short history length. It uses newly observed frames to update a low-rank adapter in the video expert, whose adapted predictions guide subsequent actions. The updates accumulate within each episode and are reset between episodes, allowing past observations to influence decisions after they leave the input window. LoCo-WAM thus learns from a longer stream of experience without expert action labels, additional data or meta-training. Experiments on two world-action models show improved task success across four simulation benchmarks. On RoboCasa GR-1, a model with 2.4,s of history matches one

translated_title: LoCo-WAM：将测试时训练作为世界-动作模型的长上下文
translated_abstract: 世界-动作模型通过预测接下来会发生什么来指导机器人动作，但通常仅依赖于较短的观测历史。扩展这一历史会增加每次决策时的计算量，并且可能需要单独训练一个模型。我们提出了 LoCo-WAM，它在保持相同短历史长度的同时，通过测试时训练从自身动作的结果中学习。它利用新观测到的帧来更新视频专家中的低秩适配器，其适配后的预测用于指导后续动作。这些更新在每个回合内累积，并在回合之间重置，使过去的观测在离开输入窗口之后仍能影响决策。因此，LoCo-WAM 无需专家动作标签、额外数据或元训练，即可从更长的经验流中学习。在两个世界-动作模型上的实验表明，该方法在四个仿真基准上均提升了任务成功率。在 RoboCasa GR-1 上，一个仅有 2.4 秒历史的模型能够匹配……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: LoCo-WAM 通过测试时训练利用新观测帧更新视频专家中的低秩适配器，使世界-动作模型在不延长观测窗口、无需专家动作标签、额外数据或元训练的情况下从更长的经验流中学习，从而在四个仿真基准上显著提升任务成功率。
